name: Evafresh Air Freshener
tagline: A fresh, floral room in seconds
shortDescription: Trigger-spray air freshener with a light floral fragrance.
description: Freshen living rooms, bedrooms, bathrooms and cars with a few sprays of Evafresh Air Freshener.
ingredients: [PLACEHOLDER] Add the ingredient list exactly as printed on your label.
howToUse: Spray 2–3 times into the air, away from your face.
Do not spray onto fabrics or polished surfaces.

dilution.ratio: Ready to use — no dilution needed

safety: Keep out of reach of children. Do not spray towards eyes or face. Do not spray near flames.
